name: Pressure Washer Spray Gun
definition: A hand-operated high-pressure valve assembly between the hose and lance; pressure, flow, temperature, inlet, outlet, locking and machine-system limits must be approved together.
includedScope: Consumer and professional pressure-washer trigger guns
Hose, lance, quick-connect and threaded interface checks
excludedScope: Unapproved field modification of pressure-bearing parts
headline: Pressure, temperature, flow and both connections define the spray-gun approval boundary.
description: This profile compares official consumer, professional and recoil-assisted spray-gun families without treating a common connector appearance as universal fit.
metaDescription: Pressure washer spray gun ratings, trigger-valve designs, connection standards, safety locks and exact compatibility checks.
disclaimer: Physical resemblance, matching wattage, matching voltage, a generic family name or a seller claim does not establish compatibility. Verify the current manufacturer part number and revision, machine model and serial scope, mechanical, electrical and fluid interfaces, rated operating envelope, protection requirements and approved service documentation.
